desc: Radical Defense introduces the Monolith-7.62 Titanium Suppressor. Utilizing the most cutting-edge technologies in 3D Additive Manufacturing, the Monolith-7.62 is one of the lightest weight, most durable suppressors on the market to date. Tested on everything from .22 WMR to 300 WM, all calibers are hearing safe. The internal design creates a robust super structure unachievable through traditional manufacturing methods. Constructed wholly of Titanium 6Al-4V, the Monolith-7.62 has a high strength-to-weight ratio creating a durable and the lightest weight commercially available suppressor for everyday use.
